question: **Direction: Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is "Anarcy." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The incorrectly spelt word is **"Anarcy."** • The correct spelling is** "Anarchy."** • **"Anarchy" **means a situation in which people do not obey rules and laws; a situation in which there is no government in a country. (शासनहीनता की स्थिति; अराजकता) • **Example**: The civil* war has led to **anarchy**__.* • Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Adverse: **acting against or in a contrary direction. (विरुद्ध या विपरीत दिशा में कार्य करना) • **Annul: **to state officially that something is no longer legally valid or recognized. ((किसी क़ानून, समझौते आदि को) रद्द करना, निरस्‍त करना) • **Adulterate: **to make food or drink less pure or of lower quality by adding something to it. (किसी खाद्य पदार्थ में मिलावट करना; अपमिश्रण करना) 3b:T7b1, The correct answer is **"To be old, often too old to do something."**
